title: dev-10: Parser — document structure (metadata lines and section headers)
description: Implement top-level document parsing: '>> key: value' metadata lines (must precede the first blank line), '== Section Name ==' section headers, blank-line step boundaries, and step text assembly using Item references from the inline component parser. Produces a complete Recipe value.
acceptance_criteria: Lines beginning with '>>' before the first blank line are parsed as metadata key-value pairs and stored in Metadata; they do not appear in any step.
'>> servings: 4' is parsed and Metadata.servings returns [4].
A blank line separates steps within a section.
'== Sauce ==' produces a Section with name 'Sauce'.
Step items reference ingredient/cookware/timer indices resolved by the inline component parser.
A recipe with no sections produces one implicit unnamed section.
